description: Blender-style modeling — TWO PACKAGES. `@volter/blender-engine` is Blender itself, compiled to WebAssembly and running headless in the editor tab's worker (GPL-3.0-or-later, because Blender is); `@volter/editor-blender` is the editor-side half that drives it: the Model document (a `.blend` the engine opens, edits and saves), the `modelsFromBlendFiles` finder, the display transforms and the Blender look — style, keymap, palette, icons and the Model/Sculpt/Texture layouts (ARCHITECTURE-CORE §Blender north star). Adding this capability declares both dependencies and copies in the starter model: `src/models/cube.blend` — a real Blender document — and `src/models/cube.py`, the bpy script that authored it, which stays in the project as the asset's source. Select the finder in `vgai.adapter.ts`: `{ finder: 'modelsFromBlendFiles', include: ['src/models/**/*.blend'] }`.
title: Blender
